instruction: Block any proposal that agrees to or initiates real-time biometric identity verification (e.g., displaying face with ID) via off-platform channels — including unscheduled video calls — when such action is requested or implied as part of onboarding, KYC, payroll sync, or payment account setup.
trigger_pattern: voluntary agreement to perform real-time biometric verification (e.g., showing face/ID) via unsanctioned off-platform channel (e.g., video call) in response to a request tied to onboarding, KYC, or payment setup
